primary_outcome: DSR = deadline-satisfied generated requests / all generated service requests
statistical_unit: training seed; average paired workload seeds within each seed
uncertainty: paired crossed bootstrap over five training seeds and ten workload seeds, following analyze_canonical_suite.paired_effect
mechanism_checks: verify lower_no_attention switches both lower actor and critic to MLP while retaining the same upper actor, quality mask and adaptive constraint mode
verify no_penalty disables only the adaptive constraint term; fixed MBS reward term remains
measure nonzero multipliers and actual adaptive penalty in hierarchical training
integrity_gates: 150 training jobs and 1650 evaluation jobs completed
all files and source hashes match source lock
paired exogenous traces match across methods
no missing or extra evaluation episodes
interpretation: Treat lower_no_attention as an architecture ablation, not an isolated attention-weight intervention. Treat no_penalty as removal of the adaptive constraint term, not all MBS penalties. Report effect sizes and confidence intervals without episode pseudoreplication.
